name: hud_sensor_tracker_register_global_on_exit
description: HudSensorTracker::RegisterGlobalOnExit registers ShutdownGlobal with the CRT atexit provider. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation and disassembly at 0x417370 show a push of HudSensorTracker::ShutdownGlobal followed by a call to the accepted CRT atexit provider.
The callback target HudSensorTracker::ShutdownGlobal is dependency-ready and functional-equivalent; atexit is covered by the accepted CRT provider boundary.
The native register-global-on-exit smoke registers the callback on a constructed global tracker and lets the isolated smoke process run registered atexit callbacks at process exit.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x417370 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
